state: Goal `core-time-datetime`: `Core\Time\DateTime::date`, `::dayOfYear`, `::difference`, `::toInstant`, `::timeOfDay`, `::zone`, `::weekday`, `::isLeapYear`, `::format` and `::plus` have every feature proof, perf figure included. Every `Core\Cldr`, `Core\Time`, `Core\Time\Date` and `Core\Time\DateTime` figure was re-measured against the current `time.rs` and `cldr.rs`, so those floor checks pass. **A perf figure is a session's job, not the driver's**: after any edit to `time.rs` or `cldr.rs` outside its test module, run `bun nv proofs --record-perf` over all four groups before the wrap (the test module does not move the impl hash). Seven members still owe proofs: `minus`, `next`, `previous`, `with`, `withTime`, `startOf`, `endOf`. The Rust tests share helpers at the end of the `time.rs` test module: `zone_view_samples()`, `datetime_view` for a view member, `datetime_formatted`, and `datetime_stepped(member, at, count, unit_index)` for a builder that takes a count and a `Core\Unit` (the unit is its case index: Day 6, Week 7, Month 8, Year 10). `bun nv proofs --id` may still print `help: … has no class card` from a stale binary. The card is at `time.rs:1589`. Nothing is blocked.
